title: Spa therapist monitor display controls
objective: Tampilkan status terapis pada monitor dan izinkan pengguna berhak memilih kode atau nama lengkap sesuai kebijakan lokasi layar.
implementation_steps: Inspect actual UI components and permission API
Implement public view defaulting to therapist code and internal authorized name option
Review with Impeccable or OpenDesign if installed and collect screenshots
acceptance: Public display never shows full name by default
Unauthorized role cannot reveal name by URL or client state
Reduced motion and keyboard interactions supported
notes: Illustrative design task; commands become enforceable after scaffold.
